title: 咖啡的账

lines.text: 年底，总公司要求各部门削减开支，周经理召集大家开会，讨论明年哪些钱可以省下来。
lines.py: nián dǐ, zǒng gōng sī yāo qiú gè bù mén xuē jiǎn kāi zhī, Zhōu jīng lǐ zhào jí dà jiā kāi huì, tǎo lùn míng nián nǎ xiē qián kě yǐ shěng xià lái.
lines.en: At the end of the year, head office tells every department to cut spending, and Manager Zhou calls a meeting to discuss what money can be saved next year.
